Obtain log-fold changes and p-values for all genes in all cell types.

Source: R/epipot.R
parse_limma_results.Rd

Obtain log-fold changes and p-values for all genes in all cell types.

Usage

parse_limma_results(limma_fit)

Arguments

limma_fit

A fit object returned by limma.

Value

A data frame containing, for all cell types (column "cell") and genes ("gene"), log-fold changes ("logFC") and p-values ("P.Value", "adj.P.Val"), as well as the remaining columns returned by `limma::topTable()`.
